title: Source-authentication addendum entry (draft v1)
description: One row of an append-only authentication addendum. Canonical key: full sha256 of the held bytes. Draft rows are never effective; only an entry with owner_decision=APPROVED, a resolvable decision_record_ref and a reviewer_ref may take effect, and only through the overlay reader described in INTEGRATION_ARCHITECTURE.md.
x-rules: every ref in evidence_refs, identity_refs and first_class_record_ref must resolve to an existing committed file and row key
first_class_record_ref must be a record whose OWN sha256 equals the entry sha256 (not a sibling copy's record, not a locator mention)
owner_decision=APPROVED requires entry_status=APPROVED, a decision_record_ref naming a committed, hash-pinned decision file, and a reviewer_ref
proposed_class NON_PRIMARY_* never yields EFFECTIVE_PRIMARY and therefore never an exact anchor
draft files are regenerated; merged addendum versions are immutable (hash-pinned in a chained manifest)
